status: candidate reference, derived and self-checked by its author TASK; no independent refutation has been made yet
deliverable: DEL-04-10 (response spectrum: CLM-001 recovery), on DEL-04-09's modal basis

number_format.flush: a value below 1e-50 of the largest magnitude of its unit in its block is printed as 0; a value between 1e-50 and 1e-35 of it is refused at generation

precision_convergence.statement: Every variant was recomputed in full at 110 digits. Each published 40-digit decimal equals the 110-digit result's, or differs from it by at most one unit in the 40th digit where the value lies at a rounding boundary; no flush decision differs. Check residuals (two-digit values) depend on the working precision by design and are not compared.

ex_mill_corrosion_witness.statement: W1-MILL (S1 c_m 1/1024 -> 2/1024 m) and W1-CORR (S1 c_a 3/1024 -> 4/1024 m) give identical published values in every block except their own inputs: on the EX basis metal and stiffness are on the nominal wall and only the pressure bore, through t_r = t - c_m - c_a, sees either allowance.

section_contrast.statement: S1 section bases on EX and PF for the mill and corrosion variants (exact rational coefficients of pi). EX: metal, jbar and A, I, J on the nominal wall; contents on the pressure bore. PF: metal, contents and A, I, J on t - c_m; c_a absent. No PF modal or spectrum analysis is published here.

variant_summary.statement: Selected combined magnitudes under the base request (CQC, missing mass on with SRSS, directional SRSS) for every variant, with the ratio to W1-BASE.

f2_replay.statement: The fresh recovery and combination code of this generator, run on the frozen f2 discrete inputs of C3-BASE (rigid response, every direction) and C9-Y (inclined members, member axes), reproduces their published values. This is an implementation control: both packages share the pinned f1 formation modules, so it is not independent evidence for them. Differences are reported, never fitted.
